predecessors.name: Holy Roman Empire
predecessors.text: the county 'established about 1140', named for Tyrol Castle near Meran

successors.name: House of Habsburg
successors.text: 'she bequeathed the county to Rudolph IV of Habsburg, Duke of Austria in 1363'; 'The Habsburgs also acquired the County of Tyrol from Henry's daughter Margaret in 1363'

ledger.x: About 1140: 'The (Princely) County of Tyrol was an estate of the Holy Roman Empire established about 1140.'
1253: the counts of Gorizia take Tyrol.

ledger.cp: unnamed Adige and Inn valley lords

wars.name: Luxembourg siege of Tyrol Castle
wars.outcome: Charles IV 'besieged Tirol Castle in 1347 and failed to take it' and burned Bozen and Meran; in 1349 he dissolved his brother's marriage to Margaret under canon law.

wars.name: Tyrolean succession (Habsburg against Wittelsbach)
wars.outcome: 'Stephen II of Bavaria then invaded' in 1363; Margaret ceded Tyrol to Rudolf IV; the 1369 Peace of Schaerding 'settled the Tyrol conflict between Albert III of Austria and Stephen II of Bavaria' with financial compensation due on Margaret's death.

certainty.note: The pages give castles, valleys and rulers, not boundaries; the shapes are admin1 and circle readings.
